name: gizza-ai/pagerank-ranker
summary: Compute PageRank scores from an edge list or adjacency matrix

tool.description: Compute PageRank scores for a directed or undirected graph supplied as an edge list or adjacency matrix. Supports weighted edges, damping, convergence tolerance, dangling-node policy, personalization, top-N truncation, and text/JSON/CSV output. Reports ranks, scores, share of total mass, in/out degree, convergence status, and dangling nodes.

damping.description: PageRank damping factor: probability of following a link instead of teleporting. Default 0.85.

dangling.description: How to handle dangling nodes with no outgoing links: redistribute their mass through teleportation, keep it as a self-loop, or drop it.

directed.description: Treat edges as one-way links. Turn off to symmetrise each edge into both directions.

format.description: Output format: readable table, JSON, or CSV.

input.description: Graph as an edge list (one edge per line, e.g. `a -> b` or `a,b,2`) or a square adjacency matrix. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.

input_format.description: How to read the input. auto treats a square all-numeric paste as a matrix and everything else as an edge list.

max_iter.description: Maximum power-iteration steps before reporting non-convergence. Default 100.

personalization.description: Optional teleport weights as node:weight pairs, e.g. `home:0.7, docs:0.3`. Blank means uniform teleportation.

tolerance.description: Convergence threshold on total L1 score change between iterations. Default 1e-6.

top.description: Show only the top N ranked nodes. 0 shows all nodes.

weighted.description: Use edge-list weight columns or matrix cell values as weights. When false, every nonzero edge counts as weight 1.
